notes.title: DEMO HOTFIX RELEASED: Critical Bug Fixes & Comfort Improvements!
notes.content: [p][b]Hello Shop Owners![/b][/p][p]Thank you for your overwhelming interest and valuable feedback on our DVD Store Simulator demo! To make your demo experience even smoother and more enjoyable, we've just released a quick hotfix. This patch includes critical bug fixes that could break the game, gameplay balancing, and some important revisions for a more comfortable gaming experience.[/p][p]We've been working quickly to address these issues, some of which were identified through your feedback and others through our internal testing.[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue occurring when adjusting the FOV setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't save after acquiring lights.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where customer products at the cash register would not spawn correctly upon loading the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed products spawning at the cash register falling to the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the FPS adjustment dropdown options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the POS system wouldn't accept single-digit numbers when taking payments.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue where keyboard inputs wouldn't work on the POS system in some keyboard layouts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a brightness issue with in-store lights during game save/load states.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements Made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the rate of trash spawning inside the shop, making cleaning more manageable.[/p][/*][*][p]Interaction with the computer and cash register is now possible by clicking their screens, providing easier usability.[/p][/*][*][p]The duration of a day has been slowed down, allowing for more time within the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Open/Closed" sign outside the shop can now also be interacted with from inside.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We are currently aware of and actively working on an issue where quitting the game takes a bit longer than expected in some situations. We aim to fix this in the next update.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback is incredibly helpful in improving our game! Please continue to share your experiences and suggestions with us.[/p][p][b]Haven't tried the demo yet? Download it now on Steam and start building your dream DVD store![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773160/DVD_Store_Simulator_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Don't forget to add our game to your Wishlist to be notified when the full version is released![/p][p][b]Happy gaming![/b][/p]

notes.title: DVD Store Simulator is officially part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
For the first time, you will be able to step into the shoes of a nostalgic shopkeeper and run your own DVD, figure and technology store.
Buy products, organize shelves, deal with customers and grow your store - all in a retro urban atmosphere.

🔸 What to Expect in the Demo:
[list]
[*] 3 product categories to manage (DVDs, Figures, Tech)
[*] Shelf management, pricing, and customer sales
[*] Customization props and light decoration
[*] Day-night cycle & store cleaning
[*] Sound, localization (EN + TR), and more!
[/list]
📝 Wishlist the game and get ready to open your doors on June 9.
Thanks for all your support — we can’t wait to hear what you think!
